subject.title: fix(feishu): retry once on token-invalid errors 99991663/99991664 with cache invalidation (fixes #97287)

question: Should this proof-positive branch become the canonical fix for https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/97287, or should maintainers prefer the competing callback-oriented implementation in https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/97431?
rationale: Both open PRs change the same Feishu authentication and message-delivery invariant, and choosing the permanent cache-owner API and invalidation scope requires an area-owner decision before either branch lands.

options.title: Adopt this branch
options.body: Use this PR as the canonical fix after narrowing or explicitly accepting its cross-account cache invalidation and refreshing exact-head checks.

options.title: Prefer the competing PR
options.body: Choose https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/97431 only after it proves ordinary send, reply, and CardKit recovery with equivalent live evidence.

options.title: Replace both branches
options.body: Close both implementation candidates only if an owner supplies a narrower account-scoped patch with the same one-shot recovery proof.

recommendation.title: Adopt this branch
recommendation.body: Use this PR as the canonical fix after narrowing or explicitly accepting its cross-account cache invalidation and refreshing exact-head checks.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent history connects this contributor most directly to the Feishu client-cache and send-path boundaries whose permanent API shape must be selected.
